title: Phone list cards: while selecting, a tap on a link cell opens the link instead of ticking the card
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Follow-up from #35883 / #35884 (PR #36024, the phone list cards and the floating selection bar). Under epic #35880.

## What happens

On the phone list, after 「⋮ More」 → 「Select」 (or a long press), the cards are in selection mode and a tap ticks a card. A tap that lands on a link cell inside the card (an email, a phone number, a URL, a lookup name) opens the link instead of ticking the card.

## Expected

While a selection is open, every tap on a card ticks or unticks it, links included, as phone apps do in selection mode. Links work again when the selection ends.

## To do

1. While the list publishes an open selection, cards swallow taps on their link cells and toggle the card instead.
2. Pin it: in selection mode, a tap on a card's email cell ticks the card and opens nothing; after × the same tap opens the link.

## Acceptance

- In selection mode on the phone, no tap on a card opens a link or a record; each tap toggles the card.

Blocked-by: #36024
